$comment: Single source of truth for every colour, metric and duration in 据实. scripts/gen-tokens.mjs generates web/src/styles/tokens.css and ios/Countbook/Design/Tokens.swift from this file. A hex value must never be written anywhere else.

color.$doc: Direction 靛与朱 (2026-09): a ledger as an object. Grounds are 宣纸 (warm paper), ink is warm black. Colour has four roles: indigo (靛青) is structure — the hero ground, the selected rule, the standard line; over (朱砂 cinnabar) is the live negative allowance, the stamps and the 记 button; held (amber) is cooling / pending; spared (青绿) is a gain, a saving, a confirmed sync. Regret stays in `lead`, a dead grey used for nothing else.

surface.use: cards, sheets, rows, the tab bar

ink300.use: units, 分, timestamps, placeholders, resting tab marks

figOver.use: 朱砂 — negative 今日可用, category above standard, the stamps

figSpared.use: 青绿 — a gain, 已放弃 / 已省 totals, a confirmed sync

figRegret.use: ONLY: 后悔金额 — dead lead, never urgent

accentInk.use: the 记 button fill — the one seal on the page

indigo.use: 靛青 — the selected rule, the standard line, the active tab

indigoGround.use: the 今日可用 ground: the ledger cover

onIndigo.use: figure and title on the indigo ground

onIndigoMuted.use: provenance line on the indigo ground

overOnIndigo.use: a negative figure on the indigo ground

bar.use: the month strip: a day under the line

radius.$doc: Web circular corners read heavier than iOS continuous corners at the same number, so each role carries two values chosen to look identical rather than to measure identical.

type.$doc: px values are the reference at the default text size; web expresses them in rem against a 16px root so browser zoom and iOS Dynamic Type both scale the whole system. Figures (hero / screen / section / row) set in the serif figure face — New York on Apple, Songti / Noto Serif elsewhere — which has no light weight, so they sit at 400.

motion.$doc: One curve, no springs, no overshoot.

elevation.$doc: Exactly one shadow exists, on the capture sheet and modals. Everywhere else depth is value and rule weight.

rule.$doc: Product constants that the UI prints, so they live beside the design values rather than being buried in logic.
